When STimingView is eventually split into a trace-agnostic base class (TraceInsightsCore) and a TimingProfiler-specific derived class, annotations belong in the base as a generic feature. The intended direction is to register the annotations extender as an IModularFeatures implementation alongside other plugin extenders (see GetExtenders) and drive it through generic ITimingViewExtender hooks or a dedicated interface, removing both the type-specific access and the module dependency. The current direct access is scoped to these private handlers and the TraceInsights module, so it can be migrated without touching external callers.

Safe because FTraceInsightsModule is process-lifetime: loaded once at IMPLEMENT_MODULE and never unloaded in standalone UnrealInsights or the editor. The extender lives as a value member of the module, so the address is stable for the widget's lifetime. If the module ever becomes unload/ reload-capable at runtime, this needs FModuleManager::OnModulesChanged invalidation.
